title: Deathtrap
description: A cat-and-mouse game ensues when a blocked Broadway playwright (Michael Caine) and his wife (Dyan Cannon) meet a fan (Christopher Reeve) with an excellent script.

title: Ten Little Indians
description: Unwary houseguests meet their deaths when they are invited by an unknown host to a secluded mountain mansion.

title: A Night of Adventure
description: A lawyer (Tom Conway) tries discreetly to defend his wife's (Audrey Long) artist boyfriend for murder.

title: Upperworld
description: Blackmail and bullets end a married New York businessman's (Warren William) affair with a chorus girl (Ginger Rogers).

title: Private Detective 62
description: A down-and-out private eye (William Powell) falls for a woman (Margaret Lindsay) he has been hired to frame.

title: Second Chance
description: A hit man (Jack Palance) catches a gangster's ex-girlfriend (Linda Darnell) and her boxer lover (Robert Mitchum) on a mountain cable car.

title: The Secret Bride
description: An attorney general (Warren William) secretly marries the daughter (Barbara Stanwyck) of a governor accused of bribery.

title: Danger Signal
description: A suave schemer (Zachary Scott) flees to California, where he preys on two sisters (Faye Emerson, Mona Freeman) for a payoff.

title: Betrayed
description: A waitress (Kim Hunter) suspects her new husband (Dean Jagger), and another man (Robert Mitchum) she knows, of murder.

title: The Secret Fury
description: The man (Robert Ryan) a woman (Claudette Colbert) was going to marry tries to find the killer who's trying to drive her mad.

title: Shadow of Doubt
description: When a Hollywood producer is murdered, the most likely suspect is a man who is smitten with the victim's fiancée.

title: 100 Rifles
description: A sheriff helps a bank robber and a Yaqui beauty fight a tyrant general in 1912 Mexico.

title: The Greatest
description: Boxer Cassius Clay (Muhammad Ali) trains with Angelo Dundee (Ernest Borgnine), becomes heavyweight champion and converts to Islam.

title: Black Eye
description: An ex-police officer operating a private detective business comes face to face with a syndicate-backed dope ring.

title: Black Belt Jones
description: A martial artist (Jim Kelly) helps a father (Scatman Crothers) and daughter (Gloria Hendry) save their school of self-defense from Los Angeles mobsters.

title: Hit Man
description: An avenger (Bernie Casey) wades through the Los Angeles porno underworld in the name of his dead brother.

title: MGM Parade Show
description: The concept allows the viewer to see the inner workings of a movie studio and featured interviews with MGM stars and explanations of how movies were made; the format changed to show edited versions of MGM films.

title: Cain and Mabel
description: A chorus girl (Marion Davies) and a heavyweight boxer (Clark Gable) are paired romantically as a publicity stunt.

title: Brother Rat and a Baby
description: Virginia Military Institute graduates keep busy as an illustrator, football coach and rich man's son.

title: Susan and God
description: A socialite (Joan Crawford) annoys her husband (Fredric March) and friends with the new religion she brings home from England.

title: Damon and Pythias
description: Greek tyrant Dionysius puts the friendship of two men (Don Burnett, Guy Williams) to a life-or-death test.

title: Abbott and Costello in Hollywood
description: Two bumbling barbers (Bud Abbott, Lou Costello) act as agents for an unknown singer and stage a phony murder to get him a coveted role.

title: Judge Hardy and Son
description: The judge (Lewis Stone) guides Andy (Mickey Rooney) through problems with girls, money and an essay contest.

title: Bonnie and Clyde
description: Acclaimed account of the gun-toting bank robbers and the trail of terror they blazed through the Southwest in the '30s.

title: Tarzan and His Mate
description: British ivory hunters want the ape man (Johnny Weissmuller) and Jane (Maureen O'Sullivan) to take them to an elephant graveyard.

title: The Beguiled
description: Southern girls and their headmistress (Geraldine Page) punish a sly, wounded Union soldier (Clint Eastwood).

title: The Sentinel
description: A New York fashion model (Cristina Raines) rooms in an old brownstone with creepy tenants and a basement gate to hell.

title: I Walked With a Zombie
description: Nurse Betsy Connell (Frances Dee) is hired to care for Jessica, a woman who suffers from a bizarre condition. When she falls for Jessica's husband, Betsy is drawn into the dark world of voodoo while trying to cure her.

title: Bedlam
description: A portly lord (Billy House) sends an 18th-century London actress (Anna Lee) to a madman's (Boris Karloff) insane asylum.

title: Carnival of Souls
description: After taking a job as a church organist, the sole survivor of a fatal car crash encounters phantoms that lure her to a deserted carnival outside of town.

title: Corridors of Blood
description: A 19th-century London doctor (Boris Karloff) becomes addicted to anesthesia and makes a deal with grave robbers.

title: Black Cats and Broomsticks
description: Examining the role of superstitions, personal rituals, taboos, talismans and the black arts in mid-20th century America.

title: George Hall and His Orchestra
description: George Hall and his orchestra are stranded and decide to sleep on the stage of a potentially haunted theater in this short film.

title: Dr. Crippen
description: In 1910 London, Dr. Hawley Harvey Crippen (Donald Pleasence) stands trial for the murder of his wife (Coral Browne).

title: Chamber of Horrors
description: A killer chops off his hand to escape, keeping house-of-wax owners guessing in the 1880s Baltimore.

title: Spider Baby
description: A servant (Lon Chaney Jr.) watches over family members who, by the age of 10, begin devolving into primitive, cannibalistic creatures.

title: White Zombie
description: A plantation owner takes the help of a voodoo master to lure an innocent woman, even though she loves someone else.

title: The Walking Dead
description: An executed convict returns from the grave to revenge himself against the gangsters who framed him for murder.

title: Mad Love
description: A bald surgeon (Peter Lorre) grafts a killer's hands on to the pianist husband (Colin Clive) of an actress (Frances Drake) he loves.

title: Eyes Without a Face
description: A Paris surgeon (Pierre Brasseur) tries to fix his daughter's (Edith Scob) face with skin from kidnapped women.

title: The Haunting
description: An anthropologist (Richard Johnson), an heir and two ESP-prone women (Julie Harris, Claire Bloom) explore a New England mansion.

title: Curse of the Demon
description: In England a U.S. psychologist (Dana Andrews) seeks to return a doctor's (Niall MacGinnis) ancient death-curse scripted on parchment.

title: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive
description: Vincent Price: What Keeps Us Alive

title: The Fly
description: A scientist's genes are mixed with those of a common housefly during a botched teleportation experiment.

title: House of Wax
description: A fire-scarred sculptor uses horrible methods to restore the marvelous wax creations his crippled hands cannot.

title: House on Haunted Hill
description: The owner of a haunted mansion offers a group of people reward money if they can survive a night at his scary estate.

title: The Mad Magician
description: An 1880s magician (Vincent Price) creates illusions of mayhem that work.

title: The Tingler
description: A pathologist (Vincent Price) discovers that people die of fright because of an organism on the spinal cord.

title: The Bat
description: A mystery writer (Agnes Moorehead) and her friends are stalked by a faceless throat-ripper (Vincent Price) in a haunted house.

title: The Hypnotic Eye
description: A stage hypnotist's (Jacques Bergerac) ugly helper (Allison Hayes) suggests terrible things to spellbound beauties.

title: Doctor X
description: A reporter (Lee Tracy) saves a mad doctor's (Lionel Atwill) daughter (Fay Wray) from a full-moon killer with synthetic flesh.

title: Mystery of the Wax Museum
description: The masked curator of a wax museum turns people into statues and sees his next Marie Antoinette.

title: Transylvania 6-5000
description: Two tabloid reporters (Jeff Goldblum, Ed Begley Jr.) go to a strange land to check on rumors of monsters running amok.

title: Looney Tunes: A-Haunting We Will Go
description: Daffy Duck's nephew goes trick-or-treating on Halloween, but he gets a fright when visiting Witch Hazel's house.

title: Pufnstuf
description: A boy (Jack Wild) enters a dragon's magic land, hounded by a witch who wants to steal his golden, diamond-studded flute.

title: Dracula
description: A real-estate man (Dwight Frye) visits the Transylvania castle of a 500-year-old vampire (Bela Lugosi).

title: The Mummy
description: An Egyptian mummy (Boris Karloff) searches Cairo for the girl (Zita Johann) he thinks is his long-lost princess.
